label: GO step when choosing a1, scaled by trials since last reward
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (100% of mass; essentially never at D1 or D2). 89% of mass falls on GO steps where the agent picks a1 (model_act == 1; choice logit > 8 holds 61% of mass). Magnitude depends on reward history. It is near max at GO after an unrewarded previous trial (GO & a1 & prev_reward == 0 has 99.5% precision and holds every top-quartile activation). After rewarded trials it drops off, roughly 0.4 -> 0.2 -> 0.1 -> 0 relative to max over 1, 2, 3 consecutive rewards, so a1 choices after long reward streaks are the main false positives. Weaker a2 activations, mostly after unrewarded trials, are about 11% of mass. It does not fire on D1/D2 or on GO steps with rewarded a2. The predicate uses only the choice the agent itself computes at GO, so no future variable is needed. Adding reward-streak exclusions only nudged F1 (0.757 vs 0.751), so the simpler predicate is recorded.
